protocol.aggregation: mean within dataset, LLM, method, and training seed
protocol.family_comparison: best SSAE versus best SAE within each dataset, LLM, and metric; uncertainty is the population standard deviation of paired-seed differences
protocol.matched_activation_comparison: ReLU, JumpReLU, and TopK SSAE versus SAE within each dataset, LLM, metric, and paired training seed
protocol.realized_active_axis_capacity: for nonlinear antipodal SSAEs, count independent axes whose absolute h_positive - h_negative coefficient reaches the frozen 0.01 activity threshold on cfc_train delta_z or its exact reverse; counts and fractions are aggregated only within dataset, LLM, method, and seed
protocol.representation_axis_selection: one latent response coordinate per concept selected by train-only Pearson Hungarian matching; the corresponding decoder axis is then evaluated
protocol.representation_concept_weighting: concepts averaged equally within each dataset-method-seed before seed uncertainty
protocol.representation_evaluation: signed cosine with factor-times-delta_z on cfc_test only; negative values are retained as anti-alignment
protocol.representation_orientation: orientation fixed by the sign of the latent-response train correlation, not by a separate decoder-projection fit
protocol.uncertainty: population standard deviation across training seeds
